benchmark.baseline: parent b3c52a5 with same exif/EX/CMS features
benchmark.candidate_production_code: cbe41db0db2876c522ea004cb50eb2efc5281d68; only cfg(test) admission assertion and CI/docs changed afterward
benchmark.method: Resident input; release opt; separate alternating taskset processes, three warmups. Process output computes a full-buffer rolling hash after timed decode. Medians of process medians. Rechecks retained without filtering.
benchmark.limits: CPU-0 recheck began while baseline Clippy was running. Both CPU-0 and CPU-2 runs show substantial/bimodal timing variability. Existing small-path speed change is inconclusive; no general speedup, zero-overhead or RSS claim. Large managed initial has only five timed iterations/process.

coverage: Independent Pillow LE/BE TIFF tags and nonzero JPEG XL Exif offset; ElementTree UTF-8/RDF namespaces; C libbrotli compression; C libjxl all effective payloads and every RGBA8 byte vs saved independent djxl reference
Raw and decoded bytes retained; first valid selection after malformed plain/brob candidates; multiple boxes; every TIFF prefix truncation; offset failures
Common EXIF Orientation=1; conflicting EXIF against all eight coded orientations compared to saved independent djxl references
DTD/external entities/XInclude/stylesheets refused, literal CDATA and predefined/numeric entities accepted; UTF-8/XML/encoding policy explicit
Parser-construction counters remain zero on metadata/workspace pre-admission failure, including namespace allowance; retained EXIF counts owned capacity
Aliased TIFF fields charged repeatedly; XML input/node/combined metadata/workspace failures; no initialized image/pixels/metadata on resource rejection
limits: Known-buffer/request workspace contract, not process RSS or every allocator/callback implementation detail
XMP is validated UTF-8 packet text, not RDF property extraction; unsupported/malformed optional content remains raw
EXIF uses existing TIFF type/schema support; fixed 8 MiB charged parse metadata and 64 primary IFD cap; XML fixed4 MiB/65536 nodes; no caps relaxed
Raw original tags retained; only common EXIF Orientation normalized; other source dimensions/tags not rewritten
No header-only dimension API, Viewer changes, cancellation changes, merge, release or issue closure
